newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Cenbank bond rate drops to 2.442 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Cenbank bond rate drops to 2.442 pct.

text.p: Brazil's benchmark overnight rate dropped to 2.442 percent a month, from 2.475 percent last week, at today's 4.363 billion reais sale of 56-day Central Bank Bonds (BBC), dealers said.
The auction's result was in line with market expectations, they added.
The 56-day bonds will mature on January 29. Today's auction is expected to add 137 million reais to the banking system, with 4.5 billion reais in old bonds coming due Wednesday.
